title: Income Tax Rates Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would adjust tax calculations for superannuation contributions made without a tax file number to reflect the companion proposal to increase the Medicare levy.
It would raise the Medicare levy component within the relevant rate calculation from 1.5 to 2 per cent for contributions received without tax file numbers.
The amendment would apply to assessments for the 2014-15 income year and subsequent years, within a wider package of DisabilityCare Australia tax measures.
changes: Paragraph 29(2)(a) of the Income Tax Rates Act 1986 would be amended.
The levy component used to calculate tax on contributions lacking a tax file number would increase by half a percentage point.
The revised calculation would first apply to the 2014-15 income year.
summary.affected: Trustees of complying and non-complying superannuation funds and retirement savings account providers receiving contributions without tax file numbers are affected.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Income Tax Rates Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, explaining that a Medicare levy component applying where superannuation funds or retirement savings account providers lack a tax file number would increase from 1 July 2014 to reflect the higher levy.
